race.comment: GYPSY RHYME (1) is the one to beat on the strength of a last-seen CL3 win at Ascot, where she led and beat Hedawood by a nose despite being unwanted in the market. The six-month break and new stable add some uncertainty, though she's a progressive type on what we saw last campaign. Can pick up from where she left off. ANNIE WARBUCKS (5) brings the clearest current form after sweeping home to beat EXTRA ZERO by just over two lengths at this track, and she is proven at the distance. SATIN BOW (9) won first-up at this venue over 1213m and reunites with Kyra Yuill, though her 1100m record is the main query. LEONARDO DA GREY (2) has been competitive in BM58+ company at this track and has the track-and-distance credentials to be a genuine minor threat. BESTON STREET (4) bolted in here last start and can't be discounted on the back of that effort.
